normalization_notes.url_format: All URLs are raw HTTP/HTTPS strings without Markdown wrappers, whitespace, citation fragments, or embedded JSON.
normalization_notes.sku_handling: Exact manufacturer/model/SKU identity is preserved; similar products and colors/revisions are not merged. A retailer omission of the manufacturer SKU does not create a guessed SKU.
normalization_notes.benchmark_rule: CPU PassMark CPU Mark and GPU 3DMark Time Spy Graphics Score are normalized independently. GPU model-level records may attach only through an explicit source-backed GPU_MODEL_PROXY association; they are never labeled as exact-board measurements.
normalization_notes.price_rule: Any dated listed VND price is eligible for evaluation when a real price is captured, regardless of IN_STOCK, OUT_OF_STOCK, PREORDER, UNKNOWN, or null availability. Availability remains evidence and is not a current inventory guarantee. Deleted or removed listings are excluded rather than converted to UNKNOWN.
